en: Black‑and‑white streetscape of a European town with cobbled and dirt roads, flanked by late‑19th‑century townhouses. On the left stands a fenced churchyard with large trees and a church whose tower has an onion‑shaped dome and a tall spire with a weather vane. On the right are multi‑storey buildings with shopfronts and balconies decorated with plants. Pedestrians in long dresses and hats and a man with a cart suggest an early‑20th‑century scene. German text is visible on several shop signs.
